primary_journey.title: Renter books a car and the owner approves the request
steps: As renter Alex Rivera, open the catalog and filter by Make Tesla
Open the Tesla Model Y, choose start and end dates three days apart, and review the price breakdown
Open My Bookings and see the request as Pending
Switch to owner Sarah Jenkins and open Booking Requests
Switch back to renter and open My Bookings, then refresh the page
expected: Breakdown shows days, daily rate, rental subtotal, cleaning fee and total ($280.00 for 3 days at $85 plus $25)
Request is created with status Pending
Renter sees the booking tagged Pending
Owner sees the request with renter name and dates
Renter sees status Confirmed, and it persists after refresh
